sources.location: https://europepmc.org/article/MED/38001909 (PMC10669731, Lunde et al. 2023, Biomedicines 11:2908; full text read)

claims.evidence: Paper 2.3: human bone marrow-derived mesenchymal stromal stem cells overexpressing TERT (hBMSC-TERT) differentiated to osteoblastic cells; OB-CM is the conditioned medium whose proteome is in PXD045723 (paper 2.9).
RAW files are secretome (conditioned medium) per PRIDE protocol; BTO:0002233 chosen as closest term.
Paper 2.3: hBMSC-TERT differentiated into osteoblastic cells for 14 days.
MaxQuant experiment names BASAL_n/DAY3_n/DAY14_n/DAY21_n in deposited mqpar.xml (file map EH10652-EH10682); interpretation as osteoblast differentiation time points is not described in the paper.
PRIDE protocol and paper 2.9: secretomes on EvosepOne + QExactive HF; timsTOF fleX was for cell lysates (.d files only inside LC_MS_files.zip).
mqpar.xml / paper: trypsin without proline restriction.

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C fixed; Oxidation M, Acetyl Protein N-term variable
claims.evidence: mqpar.xml parsed with sdrf tools search-params; matches paper 2.9.
mqpar.xml mainSearchTol (paper text says 6 ppm; deposited file preferred).
Inferred from MaxQuant LFQ search of Q Exactive HF data; DDA not stated verbatim.
EH10652-EH10682, each claimed once; mapping to experiments from mqpar.xml.

limitations: Only the 16 Thermo RAW files (OB-CM secretome, Q Exactive HF) are annotated. The cell-lysate timsTOF fleX .d files exist only inside the 35 GB LC_MS_files.zip (not listed as individual PRIDE files) and are not covered; mqpar_cell_lysate.xml describes 8 .d runs with no sample mapping in the deposit. A separate SDRF was not built for them.

The paper describes OB-CM from 14-day differentiated cells (3 of 4 samples reported); the BASAL/DAY3/DAY14/DAY21 x 4 labels in mqpar.xml are not explained in the paper. Time-point meaning (osteoblast differentiation stage) is taken from the labels at face value and may not be exact; replicate numbers are the label suffixes and it is unknown whether they are independent biological replicates.

Cell line recorded as paper name hBMSC-TERT; Cellosaurus has no entry by this name (hMSC-TERT CVCL_Z015 and clones exist but the clone was not stated), so cellosaurus accession/name, age, sex, passage number and disease are `not available`. parse_sdrf warns that hBMSC-TERT is not in CLO/BTO/EFO and tools check flags it as unverified; unavoidable.
organism part `culture fluid` (BTO:0002233) is an approximate term for conditioned medium.
Dissociation method not available (not stated); reduction/alkylation reagents not named. DDA inferred.
Precursor tolerance 4.5 ppm from mqpar.xml differs from 6 ppm in paper text.
Paper full text was read (Europe PMC PMC10669731); SKM-CM data are in PXD033025, not this deposit.
